_why: 2026-10-03. During Phase 5 the codex gate refused every write outside the project root, including the /tmp report path it already trusts for `h_mad_assemble_tdd.py --report-file`, so codex wrote its reports into the repo's tests/. `_tmp_report_target` admits an out-of-root write only under /tmp and never a .py. Each row removes one of those limits or the admission itself.

mutations.name: tmp-reports-refused-again
mutations._mechanism: The admission never fires, which is the defect: the contracted /tmp report path is unwritable and codex falls back to tests/.

mutations.name: python-under-tmp-admitted
mutations._mechanism: The .py exclusion goes, so codex could write production code into a checkout that lives under /tmp without that checkout's failing-test gate.
mutations.find:
if any(_load_identity().fold_py_suffix(name).endswith(".py") for name in (Path(canonical.target).name, *canonical.names)):  # M:CX-TMP-PY-NAME
        return False

mutations.name: any-out-of-root-path-admitted
mutations._mechanism: The /tmp boundary widens to the whole filesystem, so every non-Python write outside the root passes, $TMPDIR and home included.

mutations.name: the-name-check-reads-the-link-not-its-target
mutations._mechanism: The .py check reads the link's lexical name instead of the resolved and canonical names, so `notes.md -> prod.py` under /tmp writes Python through the link. The /tmp boundary still resolves the target.

mutations.name: CX-TMP-PY-NAME
mutations._mechanism: Restoring Path.suffix admits a dotfile named .py under /tmp while the x.py control remains denied.

mutations.name: CX-TMP-PY-ALLNAMES
mutations._mechanism: Checking only the resolved basename admits note.txt when a same-directory hard link is named x.py.

mutations.name: CX-TMP-PY-UNRESOLVABLE
mutations._mechanism: With an out-of-root cwd, root-relative resolution misses a dangling /tmp symlink that the cwd-relative report admission encounters. Removing the unresolvable guard admits that write.

mutations.name: CX-TMP-RELATIVE
mutations._mechanism: Removing the cwd-relative expansion makes an absent ../e/report.md resolve against the project root instead of the out-of-root /tmp cwd, so the report is refused.

mutations.name: CX-TMP-CWD-FALLBACK
mutations._mechanism: With no payload cwd, a relative target resolves against the root instead of the process cwd, so a report under /tmp reached from a process under /tmp is refused.
mutations.find:
base = Path(cwd).expanduser() if isinstance(cwd, str) and cwd else Path.cwd()
        path = base / path
mutations.replace:
base = Path(cwd).expanduser() if isinstance(cwd, str) and cwd else root
        path = base / path
